description: This file contains the implementation of the TalkModeRuntime actor, which manages speech recognition, text-to-speech synthesis, and conversation flow for a voice-enabled application. It interfaces with speech recognition, audio playback, and external TTS services, handling system configuration, lifecycle management, and real-time audio level monitoring.

classes.name: TalkModeRuntime
classes.description: An actor class managing speech recognition, TTS synthesis, and voice interaction flow, including configuration, lifecycle, and real-time audio level monitoring.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the talk runtime, managing recognition and playback accordingly.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes recognition and listening, updating internal states and UI.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Initializes and starts speech recognition using SFSpeechRecognizer.

methods.name: stopRecognition
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech recognition and cleans up resources.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Handles updates from speech recognition results, managing transcript and phase transitions.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Begins monitoring for silence duration to finalize speech input.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if the silence duration exceeds threshold to finalize the current transcript.

methods.name: finalizeTranscript
methods.description: Completes the current transcript, updates interaction phase, and initiates response processing.

methods.name: sendAndSpeak
methods.description: Sends the transcript prompt to the backend and plays the assistant's response via TTS.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Handles TTS playback of the assistant's response, choosing between external service and system voice.

methods.name: resolveVoiceId
methods.description: Resolves a preferred voice alias or ID with fallback to default voices via ElevenLabs API.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Decides whether incoming speech should interrupt ongoing playback based on confidence and energy.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Processes the audio RMS level, updating noise floor and reacting to speech energy.
